content.comment_body: Hello! Can someone assist me with recovering or opening this important file for my work?
Hi, I’m unable to open it either. Best regards, [user_name]

I encountered a similar issue recently. It happened because I was using [product_name] version 7 at home and version 6 at work. Once I upgraded my work computer to version 7, the problem was resolved. Hope this helps.
Hello, I tried opening the file using [product_name] (Program version: [version_no]), but it won’t open.
Hello, The file doesn't open with any of the tested versions, including [version_no]. Uploading the program from the device might be the only solution, unless another copy exists elsewhere. Regards,
For anyone with similar issues, try removing spaces in the file name. For instance, "Test 1.lsc" may not open, while "Test1.lsc" works.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble accessing an important file due to version mismatches and file naming issues in [product_name]. Multiple software versions failed to open the file, causing concerns about lost data and project delays. One user later highlighted that spaces in the file name may prevent the software from opening it, indicating a usability concern regarding naming conventions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to open project files reliably, regardless of software version or file name format, to prevent interruptions and minimize the risk of losing critical data.
